free_text: Biopsy is recommended because the patient presents with a PI-RADS 4 lesion and a rising PSA velocity of 2.7 ng/mL/yr, which strongly suggests progression following a prior positive biopsy. The combination of the PI-RADS 4 finding and the rising PSA trajectory, despite the prior positive result, mandates further tissue sampling to assess the current disease status. The statistical prior suggested deferral, but the retrieved evidence of high-risk imaging and PSA velocity overrides this initial suggestion.
